critical_code_review_comments: trace_print_service render_trace + router: format is not validated against an allow-list ('pdf'/'html'); an unexpected value falls through the else branch and returns the generated content with default media_type. Minor — consider explicit 400 on invalid format.
PDF Content-Disposition filename uses '/'→'-' sanitization only; other reserved chars (quotes, non-ASCII) rely on Python .replace('/', '-'). Considered safe for KSC/xxx numbers but worth noting.
